name: Combined Pancreatic Lipase-Colipase Deficiency
aliases: Congenital Pancreatic Lipase and Colipase Deficiency

criteria.description: Demonstration of markedly reduced or absent pancreatic lipase and colipase activity in duodenal fluid or pancreatic secretions
Presence of clinical signs of fat malabsorption including steatorrhea and failure to thrive
Identification of pathogenic variants in genes encoding pancreatic lipase or colipase
Exclusion of other causes of exocrine pancreatic insufficiency such as cystic fibrosis or chronic pancreatitis

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of clinical malabsorption symptoms plus confirmed deficiency of pancreatic lipase and colipase activity
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing supports diagnosis but is not mandatory; enzyme assay remains gold standard

pathognomonic.symptomName: Severe steatorrhea with bulky, foul-smelling stools
searchTerms: severe fatty diarrhea with bulky stools
excess fat in stools causing large, smelly poops

pathognomonic.symptomName: Marked deficiency of pancreatic lipase and colipase enzyme activity
searchTerms: poor fat digestion due to enzyme lack

common.symptomName: Failure to thrive with poor weight gain
searchTerms: failure to thrive with low weight
long-term diarrhea with poor nutrient absorption

common.symptomName: Fat-soluble vitamin deficiencies (A, D, E, K)
searchTerms: lack of vitamins A, D, E, K
muscle shrinking due to lack of food
baby with low energy and crankiness
mild low red blood cells from poor absorption
low blood count due to malabsorption

rare.symptomName: Peripheral neuropathy due to vitamin E deficiency
searchTerms: nerve damage from vitamin E lack
tingling and numbness due to vitamin E deficiency
peripheral nerve problems from low vitamin E

rare.symptomName: Osteopenia or rickets from vitamin D deficiency
searchTerms: bone thinning or soft bones from vitamin D lack
low bone density due to vitamin D deficiency

rare.symptomName: Coagulopathy due to vitamin K deficiency
searchTerms: bleeding problems from vitamin K lack
blood clotting issues due to vitamin deficiency
coagulopathy linked to vitamin K shortage

laboratory: Low or absent pancreatic lipase and colipase enzyme activity in duodenal fluid
Steatorrhea with elevated fecal fat content
Fat-soluble vitamin (A, D, E, K) deficiencies
Mild anemia on complete blood count
imaging: Normal pancreatic morphology on abdominal ultrasound or MRI
No evidence of chronic pancreatitis or structural abnormalities
genetic: Pathogenic variants in PNLIP (pancreatic lipase) gene
other: Improvement of symptoms with pancreatic enzyme replacement therapy

distinguishingFeatures: Deficiency limited to pancreatic lipase only

redFlags: Severe failure to thrive despite adequate caloric intake
Persistent steatorrhea unresponsive to standard treatments
Development of fat-soluble vitamin deficiency complications
